end.summary:
Practised defining food miles and identifying where food comes from.
Compared local and distant foods by travel distance.
Discussed links between longer travel, fuel, pollution, freshness, cooling and packaging.
Rohan stated that food miles describe the distance food travels to reach people.
end.parentNote: Asha practised food miles using examples such as local spinach and apples from Shimla. Rohan first focused on distance, then connected greater distance with more travel, pollution and reduced freshness; this was clarified later in the lesson. At home, ask them to compare two foods and discuss which travelled farther and why that matters.
